test_policy.notes: Standardized test scores (SAT code 2088, ACT code 2823) are optional for first-year applicants. However the international pages say every first-year international applicant 'must submit test scores of some kind': SAT/ACT or an English proficiency test (TOEFL, IELTS, GTECH CBT, Pearson PTE; the checklist also lists Duolingo).

requirements.notes: 'There is no fee to apply to the Mount'. Applications are accepted with a self-reported GPA (nursing applicants submit transcripts). International secondary transcripts must be in English in U.S. format or come with an official grading scale; otherwise a NACES translation/evaluation is needed (SpanTran, Josef Silny, WES, Global Credential Evaluators). Passport copy required. After admission: bank statements with at least three months of history and a final balance above the remaining cost of attendance, then the I-20 is sent by FedEx. Catholic-tradition, nonsectarian university in the Riverdale section of New York City.

deadlines.label: Early Action, first-year (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: International checklist: 'Early Action: November 15'. No year is printed, so fall 2027 entry is assumed.

deadlines.label: Final deadline, first-year (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: International checklist: 'Final Deadline: March 1' (no year printed; fall 2027 is assumed). The first-year page describes rolling admission with a March 1 priority date and a decision within four weeks of a complete application. Spring semester deadline is October 15.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for students from a country whose official language is not English or whose native language is not English. Waived with citizenship, residency and education in a designated English-speaking nation; four years at a U.S. high school with a B or better in non-ESL English and a 2.5 GPA; an international high school taught entirely in English with the same B / 2.5 conditions; or three college credits with a B or better in first-year English composition. Other accepted proof: GTECH CBT 1100, SAT EBRW 550, ACT English 22. Conditional admission: applicants without enough English are directed to an on-campus English language program before applying (the checklist calls it the English Language Service (ELS) program; the 2026-27 catalog says Kings Education).

english.notes: Listed as 'online TOEFL - 80'; the paper-based minimum is 550. The 1-6 scale is not mentioned.
Listed on the international checklist and in the 2026-27 catalog.

aid.notes: International applicants are reviewed for merit scholarships the same way as domestic ones: the International Student Merit Scholarship is awarded at acceptance (four years for first-year students) based on cumulative GPA and standardized test scores, renewable with a 3.2 GPA. The amount is not published for international students; the Tuition/Fees page says merit scholarships in general range from $17,000 to $30,000 per year. Premier Programs offer full-tuition or room-and-board awards. Federal aid (FAFSA) does not apply to international students.

cost.notes: 2026-27 catalog, first-year students: full-time tuition $46,500 per year (12-18 credits a term; $1,350 per credit part-time); room and board $16,200 (shared occupancy); technology fee $800, student activity fee $420 and academic service fee $700 (required fees are their sum). Student health insurance $3,006 is required unless waived with proof of coverage. Program costs average $1,000 a year for texts and supplies. The catalog does not print a total cost of attendance
